correctness.rationale: With a sources in one part and b in the other, symmetry leaves two non-source support values satisfying the stated 2 by 2 linear system. Its determinant is positive for 0<lambda<1. Solving and cross-multiplying gives exactly b>=R_x(a), b>=R_y(a), with positive denominators, so the least feasible b is the capped maximum of their ceilings and zero. The tau=lambda and tau>lambda cases follow from the one-step upper bound. Exact rational verification checks 1280 source-count cases and 28 direct subset-level linear-system cases and confirms the unique (3,3) K_10,10 profile. Those checks corroborate the symbolic proof.

final_claim: For homogeneous discounted hitting domination on K_{m,n}, the optimum is m+n for tau>lambda, min(m,n) for tau=lambda, and for 0<tau<lambda the stated one-dimensional integer minimum over a with exact ceiling thresholds R_x(a),R_y(a); K_{10,10} at (3/5,3/10) has optimum six with unique profile (3,3).
